content.comment_body: For example: L piw 512 (analog input) value online shows 230 in decimal. T DB1.DBW0 displays 230 decimal. My question is, how can I get only the value '23' instead of '230'? I do not need the trailing zero. Can someone provide a formula for editing this in [company_name] PLC programming? Thank you.

Hello! The analog input value as an integer for a 4-20mA signal ranges from 0 to 32000. This means if your sensor provides a 4mA input to the analog module, you will see 0 in DB1.DBW0; if it provides a 20mA input, you will see 32000 in DB1.DBW0. To process this signal and display the value in the desired decimal format, you need to perform a calculation using DB1.DBW0.
